Before you start, please read our Privacy Policy and Terms of Service. Here\'s how we handle your information:
You sign in with your phone number. We record this device\'s model when you sign in, for device management and account security.
Messages, files and plans you give your agents are processed in the cloud and sent to the model providers you configure. Model keys and vault passwords are stored encrypted.
Notifications stay off until you allow them. Fingerprint or face checks for approvals happen only on this device and are never uploaded.
You can review what\'s collected, turn off permissions or withdraw consent in Settings → Personal info & permissions.
ThinkTin can\'t work without your consent
ThinkTin needs your phone number to sign you in and the network to hand tasks to agents in the cloud. You can take another look, or quit.
